When money is involved, “please wait” and generic replies are NOT customer service.

I seriously regret choosing this platform. A financial service should give customers confidence and peace of mind—not make them constantly worry about whether their issue will ever be resolved.

Groww needs a reality check. A good-looking app cannot compensate for terrible support and a frustrating customer experience.

I would not recommend Groww based on my experience. There are better alternatives where customers deserve to be treated like customers.
